title: About the Studio
description: Galassia Epoxy Design is a private atelier of master craftsmen dedicated to fluid resin artistry and exotic hardwood furniture. Every commission is shaped by hand, one piece at a time, without mass production or shortcuts.

values.title: Fallen Timber Only
values.body: We source felled logs and centuries-old stock from managed forests, honoring the organic morphology of each species.

values.title: 30-Day Slow Curing
values.body: Deep-pour bio-resin undergoes temperature-stabilized curing for both bubble-free clarity and long-term stability.

values.title: Atelier Certificate
values.body: Every artwork ships accompanied by an archival steel plate certificate inscribed with a serial number and provenance.
